༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi las kyi mtha' sdud drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdug

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi las kyi mtha' sdud drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi las kyi mtha' sdud drag po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang thob dam la gnas shing bsnyen sgrub las gsum la mkhas pa'i sngags pas/ las sbyor mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis mtha' bsdu bar bya dgos pa las/ sreg pa'i las ni/ las sbyor mchod rten yongs rdzogs la brten pa dril ba'i skabs sam/ so sor rkyang par bya ba'i dus sam/ skabs gzhan du yang rung bas/ gnas sgrub khang ngam/ dur khrod sogs lho phyogs su kha bltas pa'i sa gzhi gnag cing rtsub pa'i sar/ dus ni dril sgrub dang rkyang sgrub kyi las mjug yin na skabs de nyid du dang*/ gzhan du na tshes gza' skar sbyor ba rtsub cing rtsub pa 'chi sbyor sogs la bab cing gza' dang sa bdag gdug pa can rgyu ba lo zla zhag dus nag por bab pa'am/ dmigs bya dgra yin na de'i skag dang bdun zur dgra gshed bdud gcod sogs kyi dus la bab pa/ bgegs yin na de nyid kyi lo zla zhag dus snying bzhi gang rung la bab pa'i tshe/ mi bsad/ g.yul bkye/ ro bsregs shul kyi sa ste sa sna gsum/ mkhar sgong srin can rnams kyi phye ma/ sho rbud kyi chu/ ser ba'i chu/ lha 'dre drag po gnas pa'i chu ste chu gsum gyis sbrus la stegs bu rgya dpangs mda' dang khru gang ba tsam brtsigs pa'i dbus su ma traṃ mgo lhor bstan pa'i snying khar thab khung gru gsum khru gang ba'i phyi rol du kha khyer sor gsum pa sum rim can/ rgya sol dang khrag gis nag por byugs pa'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa gdengs pa'i lte bar/ aye raṃ dang ming yig /dbus rwa bzhi la yaṃ/ rwa brgyad la aye myag 'bru brgyad/ chos 'byung gi zur gsum du dzaḥ

rtsibs bcu gnyis la e hur thuṃ dzaḥ khaṃ shag ro myag mukti rbad ya/ rtsibs mchan rnams su raṃ/ kha khyer nang ma la rtsang*/ bar mar thod ra/ phyi mar me ri bri/ rtsang gi nang du skyer pa/ mdzo mo/ kha da ra sogs dug dang tsher ma can dug khrag gis sbags pa'i khru phyed dam gang du brtsegs/ nang bud shing gis gang ba/ thab steng du me lces slebs pa'i sar gcod pa ni nam mkha'i 'khor lo dgram/ mchod pa'i rdzas khrag chen gyi arghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog /sha chen dang*/ tshil chen/ gu gul sbyar ba'i spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris chen chang dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ 'bru nag dang*/ mi dang*/ khyi'i sha rus khrag bcas kyi bshos/ dur khrod kyi rol mo/ sman raka gtor ma rnams dang*/ sbyin sreg gi rdzas la/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas yam shing la drag po'i shing zur gsum rtse mo rno ba sor bcu gnyis pa/ mar nag la mi rta nya khyi la sogs pa'i zhun gyis sbags pa/ rtsa ba'i rdzas dgra bgegs gang yin gyi liṅga ming rus dri mas sbags pa mkhyid gang ngam/ sen gang pa mang po/ drag po'i rdzas bag phye'i ril bu dug khrag gis sbags pa'i nang du ming rus bcug pa/ gnad kyi rdzas nya sbal sbrul bya phag gi sha dang gi waṃ dang ra dug la sogs pa'i dug sna dgu bsres pa/ gsod pa'i rdzas lcags phye/ rdo phye/ zangs phye/ myos pa'i rdzas dmar khrag /dme khrag /bsnol khrag la sogs pa bsres pa/ tsha ba'i rdzas til dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ tsha ba gsum rnams so// de ltar sreg rdzas bdun po thod pa'am lcags snod du gral rim du bshams/ gzhan yang rdor dril/ dgang blugs/ nyer mkho rnams 'du bya/ rnal 'byor pas skyabs sems nas tshogs lhag gi bar phrin las snying po bsdus pas gzhung bsrangs/ bzlas pa bya/ sngags pas rgyu dus kyi kun slong snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ dus kyi kun slong bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba sogs kyi zhing bcu tshar gcod pa'i zhe sdang bskyed la chas gos nag po gyon/

raksha'i phreng ba se ral kha bya/ zhing lpags kyi gdan la kha lho nub tu phyogs pas 'khod la/ yug sa ma'i khyim mam/ bshan pa'i 'am/ shing nags gdug rtsub bam/ rdo nag las byung ba'i me'am/ oṃ agna ye a sya ka dzaḥ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces rlung g.yab dang bcas pas sbar/ oṃ agna ye che ge mo dzwa la raṃ/ zhes mar nag dgang blugs bdun gyis gso/ rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas yi ge raṃ spros pas/ thab khung nyi ma'i gdan la thab dang me gnyis su med pa me'i gong bur gyur pa 'phros/ 'dus pa las/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ drag po'i me lha sku mdog nag po ra skyes la bcibs pa/ ra la 'ja' dang glog 'khyil ba/ zhing gi ya mgal gyi snga ru dang*/ sbrul nag 'khyil pas gong rmed byas pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang gha ṭī bsnams pa/ me dpung gi rgyan dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbazhi spros ye shes kyi me lha spyan drangs/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs me lha drang srong mchog /rang gi dam tshig tshul bzhin du// 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// e hye hi bha ga wān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ agni dzñā na sa ma ya ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ hūm̐ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub cing*// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// agna ye tiṣṭha lhan/ hūm̐ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /phrin las kun gyi dpang po mdzod// ting 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// agna ye a la la pra tītstsha hoḥ hūm̐ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /ra skyes bcibs shing glog bas mgyogs// sreg rdzas kun gyi phyag tshad mdzad// tshim byed khyod la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul// oṃ kro dha agna ye/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ dhū pe/ puṣpe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye hūm̐ pū dza me gha khā hi/ oṃ badzra kro dha agna ye bi ma le agna ye swā hā/ hūm̐ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /mnyam pa'i ngang las kun snang yang*// chos nyid ngang las ma g.yos pa// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// gdug rtsub dmar nag 'khyil ba'i dur khrod du// gshegs shing bzhugs nas drag po'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ badzra kro dha agna ye sarba pū dza me gha khā hi/ che ge mo'i maṃ sa la khā hi/ rakta khā hi/ keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ zhes brjod/ na mo/ rig pa'i rgyal po drang srong me lha chen po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pas sreg rdzas lha'i zhal du 'bul ba dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// bdag gi phrin las sgrub par mdzad du gsol// oṃ a pra ti ha ta dzwa la ye swā hā/ zhes yam shing dang til mar dgang blugs dang*/ hoḥ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyag bzhi pa// zhabs bzhis las bzhi 'grub par mdzad// ra skyes khams pa chibs su bcibs// ra la 'ja' dang glog gis brgyan// zhing gi ya mgal snga ru dang*// sbrul nag 'khyil pas gong rmed byas// me lce dgu phreng sku la brgyan// bram ze'i bu mo lnga brgya yang*| |khyod kyi 'khor dang g.yog yin no// kha 'bar ma yis me bus pa'i// agni rā dza 'khor bcas la// rakta dmar gyi mchod pa dang*// 'chi med bdud rtsi dpal bshos dang*// spos chen dud pa la sogs pa// sreg rdzas mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// zhe sdang khros pa'i sbyor ba chom// rtsa rgyud khrag gi rba klong skoms// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi/ agni kro dha ye gnod byed dgra bo che ge mo sogs bsgyur 'byung po dzwa la raṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i rdzas nas tsha ba'i rdzas kyi bar nyer gcig re sogs 'bul/

bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyag bzhi pa// zhabs bzhi las bzhi grub mdzad pa// las kun mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ agni dzwa la dzwa la gatstsha bha bha muḥ ye shes kyi me lha shar phyogs su gshegs te dpang po lta bur dmigs/ dam tshig me lha'i thugs ka ru// pad rdor dur khrod me ri'i nang*// 'obs chen bcu drug kun nas 'jigs// zhes pa nas/ de kho na'i mchod pa'i dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi tshe thod lnga'i nang du bzhugs zhes brjod pas dbu gtsug che mchog mthing nag gi/ zhes pa nas/ rgyas gdab gnyis med brtan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar skabs 'dir mi brjod par phyag 'tshal sogs dkyus ltar sbyar ro// mchan/ bar/ mtshams de'i 'dod don gsol ba dor nas/ hūm̐ chos nyid rnam dag 'od gsal mkha' klong nas/ zhes pa nas/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ liṅga rnams la dgug 'dren drag po byas te/ hūm̐ bskal pa brgyad khri bzhi stong 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// lcags mkhar sgo med bcu drug 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs nas// 'obs chen bcu drug 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus phyogs nas// pho brang lcags mkhar spu gri gtams pa nas// klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan// lto 'phye phyogs skyong ma he brdzis pa'i khrir// thabs dang shes rab nyi zla'i gdan steng nas// srog bdag tshe bdag nag po sku bzhengs shig /rngams pa'i tshul gyis bla rkun las la khyer// dzaḥ shar gyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// dung gi mon pa seng ge'i mgo// dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs// phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsitta dgu// zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug /spyan dgus dgra bgegs bltas nas 'dzin// snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la 'dzin// phyag dgus tsitta khong nas 'byin// zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol// ljags dgus nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung*// dgra bgegs ma lus khug la shog

/dzaḥ lho yi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// lcags kyi mon pa stag gi mgo// dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs// phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsitta dgu// zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug /spyan dgus dgra bgegs bltas nas 'dzin// snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la 'dzin// phyag dgus tsitta khong nas 'byin// zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol// ljags dgus nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung*// dgra bgegs ma lus khug la shog /dzaḥ nub kyi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// bse yi mon pa dred kyi mgo// dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs// phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsitta dgu// zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug /spyan dgus dgra bgegs bltas nas 'dzin// snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la 'dzin// phyag dgus tsitta khong nas 'byin// zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol// ljags dgus nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung*// dgra bgegs ma lus khug la shog /dzaḥ byang gi phyogs nas bla 'gugs pa// gser gyi mon pa khyung gi mgo// dbu dgu spyan dgu zhal dgu gdangs// phyag dgu zhabs dgu tsitta dgu// zhabs dgus stong gsum bla la rgyug /spyan dgus dgra bgegs bltas nas 'dzin// snying dgus dgra bgegs yid la 'dzin/ */ phyag dgus tsitta khong nas 'byin// zhal dgus kha mngar med par gsol// ljags dgus nyams pa'i khrag la 'thung*// dgra bgegs ma lus khug la shog /hūm̐ srog bdag tshe bdag nag po ni// sku ni nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam// thugs ni stong gsum khyab par lta// gsung ni nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /zhal ni hom khung gdangs pa 'dra// ljags ni hom gzar bskyangs pa 'dra// mche ba rtsang phur gtams pa 'dra// khyod ni srog dbugs bdag po ste// gru gsum rngams pa'i zhal gdongs shig /yum chen gsod byed nag po ste// nad gtong rgyal mo zhal gdongs shig /'jigs byed ya ma rā dza ni// smug nag brjid pa zhal gdongs shig /dregs pa phyag na rdo rje ni// stobs chen drag po zhal gdongs shig

/rus sbal rgyal po mi bzad ni// tshe bdag khyams khang zhal gdongs shig /sgrol byed tshe bdag nag po ste// sprul pa chen po zhal gdongs shig /'chi bdag bye ba dgu khri ste// las kyi mtha' sdud zhal gdongs shig /sgrol ging bdag po rme ru rtse// srog bdag chen po zhal gdongs shig /gshin mon bdud dang 'chi bdag tshogs// zhag gshed sgo skyong zhal gdongs shig /gshin rje pho mo bdun brgya tshogs// rdo rje rigs kyi srung ma'i tshogs// ma gshin sha za yi dwags bcas// 'obs srung tshogs rnams zhal gdongs shig / liṅga rnams la phur bu gdab/ thun brab/ gri lcags kyi mtshon chas bsgral la/ hūm̐ chos dbyings drag po'i zhing khams na// zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya zil gnon thugs dam bskul// zhes pa'i bar phrin las snying po bsdus pa'i bskul ltar gyi rjes su/ gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stobs// sdang pa'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// mchod par 'bul lo kha raṃ khā hi// gdug rtsub dmar nag 'khyil ba'i hom khung 'dir// gshegs shing bzhugs nas drag po'i mchod pa bzhes// gnad rdzas gsod pa'i rdzas dang tsha ba'i rdzas// myos pa thun gyi rdzas rgod 'di bsregs pas// dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig /e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ sa nā ga du raṃ/ sa nā ga u nan gzir phyung srog la du raṃ tsitta breng shag thun rbad e raṃ 'byung po dgra bgegs che ge ma ོ sogs mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags 'dis gtso bo la sngags tshar re dang rdzas re 'grigs pa brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ long skabs ma byung na de bas nyung yang nyan no// de'ang sngags 'di'i sa nā ga zhes pa rnams ni tshe bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di gtso bor sa gdon dang dgra bgegs gzhan la kha bsgyur bar dgongs na/ sa nā ga'i mal du/ dgra yin na che ge mo a mu kaṃ zhes dang*/ bgegs gzhan la'ang de bzhin kha bsgyur la/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas nas tsha ba'i rdzas kyi bar go rim bzhin dbul/

de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das sku yi dkyil 'khor nas// zhes pa nas/ sprul pa'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskul// zhes pa'i mthar/ gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stobs// nas/ dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig / ces pa'i bar gong ltar btags la sngags snga ma nyid kyis rdzas bdun pa gtso bo las nyung tsam phul/ tshul de lta bus sprul pa gsum gshed mon bdud bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag /ma mo/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ thun bdag bzhi/ bdun brgya nyi shu/ 'obs srung bcu drug rnams/ phrin las snying po bsdus pa'i bskul le tshan re re'i mthar/ gdug rtsub me lha'i zhal du stobs// nas/ dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs myur du brlag gyur cig | ces pa'i bar so sor btags shing gong gi sngags kyi rim pas nyung du btang la rdzas bdun po tshang ba rim bzhin dbul/ de ltar gtso 'khor rnams thems nas/ hoḥ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ma lus pa'i bdag nyid khro bo thams cad kyi rje btsan zhes sogs nas/ u gra a bhi tsarya'i dgongs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol/ de nas me lha'i ye shes pa la/

oṃ agni de wa ri ṣi ma hā kro dha che ge mo dzwa la raṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces rdzas bdun po'i lhag ma rnams ma lus par grangs bcad mi dgos par rdzogs par 'bul/ sngar ltar me lha la mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ agni de wa ri ṣi dzñā na satwa badzra muḥ zhes me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ zil gnon gyi lha tshogs la mchod pa sman raka gtor ma dang bcas pa dbul/ bstod pa bya/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo longs spyad lhag ma btang*/ hoḥ phyag rgya chen po'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// zhes pa nas/ gshegs nas slar yang 'byon par gsol gyi bar/ phrin las snying po bsdus pa ltar dang*/ badzra muḥ phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ rang gis sprul pa'i dam tshig pa rnams rang gi snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ me lha dam tshig pa rnams me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i// zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog gi phrin las snying po bsdus pa ltar bya/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab/ dug khrag gis me gzhil nas thal sol rnams thab steng gi gcod pa nam mkha'i 'khor los btums la thod chen nam/ phag thod du bcug la drag po'i gnas sam/ mchod rten 'og tu mnan la/ hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// zhes pa nas/ sarba sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar phrin las snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung ltar gzir mnan gyis bro brdung*/ thal sol lhag ma rnams rlung la bskur ro// mnan pa 'di sgrub khang sogs las gzhan pa'i gnas dur khrod la sogs par yin na thab khung de nyid kyi zhabs su gnon par yang gsungs so// dmigs bsal gyi dgra bgegs gal che ba la thug pa byung na/ g.yon ro ma las byung ba/ mnan pa ri rab stobs chen bris la/ dgra yin na de'i zag pa dang*/ bgegs ngos zin na de nyid gnas pa'i sa shing chu sogs sam/

ngos ma zin na/ rlung 'dre 'tshub byas shul gyi sa byugs la gong ltar mnan no// de'ang 'di yi gzhung gtsug lag dpal dges mdzad par/ 'khor lo re la sbyin sreg gsum// 'di ni 'jam dpal rdzus skyes gzhung*| |yang na 'khor lo rtsibs gcig la'ang*// tshes nas zhag bdun sbyin sreg bya// bcu gcig sred med bu yang 'joms// zhes bya ba ni thug 'phrad glo bur bya ba'i sbyin sreg min gyi mchod rten yongs rdzogs sam rkyang pa re re'i mthar yang rung la/ sgrub mjug gi las mtha' mnan sreg 'phang gsum gyis bsdu bar dgongs pa yin no// de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed lcags sdig nag po gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs kyi las kyi mtha' sdud sbyin sreg gi cho ga gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba 'di'ang*| slob dpon chen po gtsug lag dpal dges mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg rgya gzhung*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis bsgyur ba nyid gtso bor byas pa ma gtogs gzhan pa'i gsar rnying dang lcags 'dra sogs kyis ma bslad pa 'di ni 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma mnga' ris pa dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ lcags yos snron gyi zla ba'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa gsum par rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa ste/ de'ang rgyud sde lnga nas/ rang gshed dbab pa/ snying gzer dbab pa/ stobs kyis mnan pa/ zor gyis bsad pa/ sbyin sreg gis bsad pa ste lnga las 'di nyid ni sbyin sreg gis bsad pa'i las yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
